omg.si.interpolants module#

class omg.si.interpolants.EncoderDecoderInterpolant(switch_time: float = 0.5, power: float = 1.0)[source]#

Bases: Interpolant

Encoder-decoder interpolant I(t, x_0, x_1) = cos^2(pi * (t - switch_time * t)^p / ((switch_time - switch_time * t)^p + (t - switch_time * t)^p)) * 1_[0, switch_time) * x_0

  • cos^2(pi * (t - switch_time * t)^p / ((switch_time - switch_time * t)^p + (t - switch_time * t)^p)) * 1_(1-switch_time, 1] * x_1

between points x_0 and x_1 from two distributions p_0 and p_1 at times t.

For p=1 and switch_time=0.5, this interpolant becomes I(t, x_0, x_1) = cos^2(pi * t) * 1_[0, switch_time) * x_0 + cos^2(pi * t) * 1_(1-switch_time, 1] * x_1, which was considered in the stochastic interpolants paper.

Note that the time derivatives are only bounded for p>=0.5.

Parameters:

  • switch_time (float) – Time in (0, 1) at which to switch from x_0 to x_1. Defaults to 0.5.

  • power (float) – Power p in the interpolant. Defaults to 1.0.

Raises:

ValueError – If switch_time is not in (0,1) or power is less than 0.5.

class omg.si.interpolants.PeriodicEncoderDecoderInterpolant(switch_time: float = 0.5, power: float = 1.0)[source]#

Bases: EncoderDecoderInterpolant

Encoder-decoder interpolant I(t, x_0, x_1) = cos^2(pi * (t - switch_time * t)^p / ((switch_time - switch_time * t)^p + (t - switch_time * t)^p)) * 1_[0, switch_time) * x_0

  • cos^2(pi * (t - switch_time * t)^p / ((switch_time - switch_time * t)^p + (t - switch_time * t)^p)) * 1_(1-switch_time, 1] * x_1

between points x_0 and x_1 from two distributions p_0 and p_1 at times t with periodic boundary conditions. The coordinates are assumed to be in [0,1].

For p=1 and switch_time=0.5, this interpolant becomes I(t, x_0, x_1) = cos^2(pi * t) * 1_[0, switch_time) * x_0 + cos^2(pi * t) * 1_(1-switch_time, 1] * x_1, which was considered in the stochastic interpolants paper.

Note that the time derivatives are only bounded for p>=0.5.

Parameters:

  • switch_time (float) – Time in (0, 1) at which to switch from x_0 to x_1. Defaults to 0.5.

  • power (float) – Power p in the interpolant. Defaults to 1.0.

Raises:

ValueError – If switch_time is not in (0,1) or power is less than 0.5.

__init__(switch_time: float = 0.5, power: float = 1.0) → None[source]#

Construct periodic encoder-decoder interpolant.

Get the corrector implied by the interpolant.

Returns:

Corrector that corrects for periodic boundary conditions.

Return type:

Corrector

class omg.si.interpolants.PeriodicScoreBasedDiffusionModelInterpolantVE(sigma: Sigma)[source]#

Bases: ScoreBasedDiffusionModelInterpolantVE

Interpolant I(t, x_0, x_1) = sqrt(sigma_(1-t)^2 - sigma(0)^2) * x_0 + x_1 between points x_0 and x_1 from two distributions p_0 (assumed to be Gaussian here) and p_1 at times t with periodic boundary conditions that can be used to reproduce variance-exploding score-based diffusion models.

Parameters:

sigma (Sigma) – Sigma function that defines the noise schedule.

__init__(sigma: Sigma) → None[source]#

Construct periodic VP interpolant.
